fullPassage: In today's interconnected world, people rely heavily on a handful of dominant languages. This causes a serious problem, even though it improves international cooperation, by threatening vulnerable languages. Many languages slowly die out as the younger generations first become bilingual and then gradually abandon their traditional language. It is important that efforts are made to prevent this from happening. Language is woven together with culture, and it reflects what is important to those who speak it. As a culture develops, its language grows and changes with it. But when a language is lost, the culture is at risk. Without a language to pass down stories and lessons from the past, the culture could simply disappear.

questions.passage: In today's interconnected world, people rely heavily on a handful of (A)[dominant / minor] languages. This causes a serious problem, even though it improves international cooperation, by (B)[threatening / protecting] vulnerable languages. Many languages slowly die out as the younger generations first become bilingual and then gradually (C)[preserve / abandon] their traditional language. It is important that efforts are made to prevent this from happening. Language is woven together with culture, and it reflects what is important to those who speak it. As a culture develops, its language grows and changes with it. But when a language is lost, the culture is at risk. Without a language to pass down stories and lessons from the past, the culture could simply disappear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) dominant=지배적인 / minor=사소한 (B) threatening=위협하는 / protecting=보호하는 (C) abandon=버리다 / preserve=보존하다
det.analysis:
① minor: 사람들이 '사소한' 언어에 크게 의존? dominant(지배적인)가 문맥에 맞음
② dominant — threatening — abandon: 지배적 언어 의존 + 취약 언어 위협 + 전통 언어 버림 ←정답
③ protecting/preserve: '보호하는'/'보존하다'는 문맥과 반대
④ minor/protecting/preserve: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 소수의 dominant(지배적) 언어에 의존 → vulnerable 언어를 threatening(위협) → traditional 언어를 abandon(버림)

questions.passage: In today's interconnected world, people rely heavily on a handful of dominant languages. This causes a serious problem, even though it improves international cooperation, by threatening (A)[vulnerable / powerful] languages. Many languages slowly die out as the younger generations first become (B)[monolingual / bilingual] and then gradually abandon their traditional language. It is important that efforts are made to (C)[encourage / prevent] this from happening. Language is woven together with culture, and it reflects what is important to those who speak it. As a culture develops, its language grows and changes with it. But when a language is lost, the culture is at risk. Without a language to pass down stories and lessons from the past, the culture could simply disappear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) vulnerable=취약한 / powerful=강력한 (B) bilingual=2개 국어를 쓰는 / monolingual=1개 국어만 쓰는 (C) prevent=막다 / encourage=장려하다
det.analysis:
① powerful: '강력한' 언어를 위협? 위협받는 것은 vulnerable(취약한) 언어
② monolingual/encourage: '1개 국어'/'장려하다'는 문맥과 반대
③ vulnerable — bilingual — prevent: 취약 언어 위협 + 젊은 세대가 2개 국어 사용 + 소멸을 막으려는 노력 ←정답
④ powerful/monolingual: 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 위협받는 것은 vulnerable, 젊은 세대는 bilingual이 됨, 소멸을 prevent하려는 노력

questions.passage: In today's interconnected world, people rely heavily on a handful of dominant languages. This causes a serious problem, even though it improves international cooperation, by threatening vulnerable languages. Many languages slowly die out as the younger generations first become bilingual and then gradually abandon their traditional language. It is important that efforts are made to prevent this from happening. Language is (A)[woven / separated] together with culture, and it (B)[hides / reflects] what is important to those who speak it. As a culture develops, its language grows and changes with it. But when a language is lost, the culture is at risk. Without a language to pass down stories and lessons from the past, the culture could simply (C)[flourish / disappear].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) woven=엮인 / separated=분리된 (B) reflects=반영하다 / hides=숨기다 (C) disappear=사라지다 / flourish=번성하다
det.analysis:
① separated: 언어가 문화와 '분리되어' 있다? 언어는 문화와 woven(엮여) 있음
② hides/flourish: '숨기다'/'번성하다'는 문맥과 반대
③ separated/hides/flourish: 모두 반대
④ woven — reflects — disappear: 언어는 문화와 엮여 있고 + 중요한 것을 반영하며 + 언어가 사라지면 문화도 사라짐 ←정답
det.tip: 언어=문화와 woven(엮임), 가치를 reflects(반영), 언어 상실 시 문화도 disappear(사라짐)

This causes a serious problem, even though it improves international cooperation, by threatening ②<u>vulnerable</u> languages. Many languages slowly die out as the younger generations first become bilingual and then gradually ③<u>abandon</u> their traditional language. It is important that efforts are made to prevent this from happening. Language is woven together with culture, and it reflects what is important to those who speak it. As a culture develops, its language grows and changes with it. But when a language is lost, the culture is at ④<u>risk</u>. Without a language to pass down stories and lessons from the past, the culture could simply disappear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① minor→dominant(지배적인) ② vulnerable=취약한 ③ abandon=버리다 ④ risk=위험
det.analysis:
① minor: 사람들이 '사소한' 소수 언어에 크게 의존한다? 의존 대상은 dominant(지배적인) 언어여야 함 ←정답
② vulnerable: 위협받는 취약한 언어 — 적절
③ abandon: 전통 언어를 버림 — 적절
④ risk: 문화가 위험에 처함 — 적절
det.tip: 사람들이 크게 의존하는 소수 언어 = dominant(지배적). minor(사소한)는 반대

It is important that efforts are made to prevent this from happening. Language is ③<u>woven</u> together with culture, and it reflects what is important to those who speak it. As a culture develops, its language grows and changes with it. But when a language is ④<u>saved</u>, the culture is at risk. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① improves=향상시키다 ② bilingual=2개 국어의 ③ woven=엮인 ④ saved→lost(사라진)
det.analysis:
① improves: 국제 협력을 향상시킴 — 적절
② bilingual: 젊은 세대가 2개 국어 사용 — 적절
③ woven: 언어가 문화와 엮여 있음 — 적절
④ saved: 언어가 '보존되면' 문화가 위험에 처한다? 언어가 lost(사라지면) 문화가 위험에 처하는 것 ←정답
det.tip: 언어가 lost(사라지면) 문화가 위험. saved(보존되면)는 정반대

det.korean: ① threatening=위협하는 ② meaningless→important(중요한) ③ risk=위험 ④ disappear=사라지다

③ risk: 문화가 위험에 처함 — 적절
④ disappear: 언어 없이 문화가 사라짐 — 적절

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 reflects의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: reflect: (A) (빛·상을) 반사하다 (B) (생각·가치를) 반영하다, 나타내다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: weave(엮다) → woven(엮인): be동사 뒤 과거분사로 수동태. weave-wove-woven 불규칙 변화
det.analysis: weave를 과거분사 woven으로 변환. 'Language is ___ together'는 언어가 '엮이는' 대상이라 be동사+과거분사(수동태)가 필요해요. weave는 weave-wove-woven으로 불규칙 변화해요
det.tip: be + 과거분사 = 수동태(~되다). weave의 과거분사는 woven

questions.passage: In today's interconnected world, people rely heavily on a handful of dominant languages. This causes a serious problem, even though it improves international cooperation, by threatening vulnerable languages. Many languages slowly __________ as the younger generations first become bilingual and then gradually abandon their traditional language. It is important that efforts are made to prevent this from happening. Language is woven together with culture, and it reflects what is important to those who speak it. As a culture develops, its language grows and changes with it. But when a language is lost, the culture is at risk. Without a language to pass down stories and lessons from the past, the culture could simply disappear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: grow up=성장하다 / die out=소멸하다 / carry on=계속하다 / break down=고장 나다
det.analysis:
① grow up: 언어가 '성장한다'? 뒤 문맥(젊은 세대가 전통 언어를 버림)과 반대
② die out: 젊은 세대가 2개 국어를 쓰다 전통 언어를 버리며 많은 언어가 서서히 '소멸함' ←정답
③ carry on: 계속되다 — 소멸 흐름과 반대
④ break down: 고장 나다 — 언어에 부적절
det.tip: younger generations abandon their language → 언어가 서서히 die out(소멸)

questions.passage: In today's interconnected world, people rely heavily on a handful of dominant languages. This causes a serious problem, even though it improves international cooperation, by threatening vulnerable languages. Many languages slowly die out as the younger generations first become bilingual and then gradually abandon their traditional language. It is important that efforts are made to prevent this from happening. Language is woven together with culture, and it reflects what is important to those who speak it. As a culture develops, its language grows and changes with it. But when a language is lost, the culture is at risk. Without a language to __________ stories and lessons from the past, the culture could simply disappear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: pick up=집어 들다 / give away=거저 주다 / take over=인계받다 / pass down=물려주다, 전수하다
det.analysis:
① pick up: 이야기를 '집어 든다'? 문맥 부적절
② give away: 거저 준다 — 부적절
③ take over: 인계받다 — 방향이 반대
④ pass down: 언어 없이는 과거의 이야기와 교훈을 '물려줄' 수 없어 문화가 사라짐 ←정답
det.tip: a language to ___ stories and lessons from the past → 세대에 전하는 것 = pass down(물려주다)
